# 무선통신기술의 이해 / LTE 프로세스 특강 (raw source)
> 현대자동차(Hyundai) "Next Generation Vehicle Technology" LTE 특강 슬라이드 자료, 텍스트 레이어 pdftotext 추출. 387p, OCR 가독성 중간(슬라이드 레이아웃·표 깨짐).

## Book metadata
- title: 무선통신기술의 이해 — Hyundai Next Generation Vehicle Technology, LTE 프로세스 기술 교육
- authors: 현대자동차 (내부 교육 자료; 강사 윤석현(한국대학교수), 김재현(아주대학교 교수) 등 원문에 실명 기재)
- publisher: (원문 미확인 — 내부 교육 자료, 외부 출판사 표기 없음)
- year: 2014 (원문 강연 일자 2014. 1. 8-9 / 4일차 과정표)
- authors_note: 조직(현대차) 저자 + 강사 2명 실명 — 원문에 회사/기관/강사 이름이 혼재하어 개인 저자 페이지 생성 불가
- pages: 387 (pdfinfo)
- content: LTE 시스템·OFDM/SC-FDMA·다중 안테나(MIMO)·LTE Radio Interface (PHY/MAC/RRC/RRC·RRM)·LTE-A (Rel.10/11)·핸드오버/세션 관리

## Chapter structure (from TOC / process schedule)
- **LTE 시스템 기본 무선 기술** (1일/2일차) — OFDM 및 SC-FDMA, 다중 안테나 기술(빔포밍, space-time diversity, space-time multiplexing), MIMO/IMIMO
- **LTE Radio Interface / Architecture** (2일/3일차) — LTE Physical Layer 개요, downlink·uplink 전송 규격 (OFDMA, SC-FDMA), 다중 접속 기술
- **LTE 네트워크 기술 개요** (3일) — LTE Network Architecture, user/control plane, LTE RLC/RRM, 채널 적응 스케줄링·링크 적응
- **LTE 프로토콜 / LTE-A features** (3-4일) — LTE PDCP/MAC, CoMP, heterogeneous network (HeNB), Rel.10/11 issues, D2D, MTC

     Cellular Concep                                                              喆辯色
     口 The cellular concept is a wireless system designed by dividing a
       large area into several small cells, replacing a single, high-power
       transmitter in a large area with a single, low-power transmitter in
       each cell, and reusing the frequency of a cell to another cell after
       skipping several cells.
     口 Thus, the limited bandwidth is reused in distant cells, causing a
       virtually infinite multiplication of the available frequency.
     口 To efficiently utilize the available frequency, the design of cellular
       systems depends on five basic elements:
         1. Frequency reuse;
         2. Co-channel interference;
         3. Carrier-to-interference ratio;
         4. Handover / Handoff mechanism;
         5. Cell splitting.

       RLC Overview                                                                          喆辯色
       口 Rad向 Link Contr이（RLC)
        > Located between RRC/PDCP and MAC
        > Error correction through ARQ
        > Segmentation/Concatenation/ Reassembly of RLC SDUs
        > 3 transfer modes
            V TM (Transfer Mode)
                · Only used for RRC messages which do not need RLC configuration
                · through BCCH, DL/UL CCCH and PCCH
            V UM (Unacknowledged Mode)
               · Utilized by delay-sensitive and error-tolerant real-time applications
               · through DL/UL DTCH, MCCH or MTCH
            V AM (Acknowledged Mode)
               · Utilized by error-sensitive and delay-tolerant non-real-time applications
               · through DL/UL DCCH or DL/UL DTCH

  口 Purpose
   > RA is performed when UE didn't assigned resource for data transmission

     >Contention based
       V Perform when eNB doesn't know the presence of UE or UE have data to transmit
         while UE lost timing information
       V Examples
         · Initial access from RRC IDLE
         · RRC Connection Re-establishment procedure
         · UL data arrival during RRC_CONNECTED requiring random access procedure
                )> E.g. when UL synchronisation status is "non-synchronised" or there are no PUCCH resources for
                   SR ava始b旭


     > Non-contention based
        V Perform when eNB know the incoming of UE or eNB have data to transmit while
          UE lost timing information
        V Examples
             · Handover
             ' For positioning purpose during RRC. CONNECTED requiring RA
             · DL data arrival during RRC_CONNECTED requiring random access procedure
                '> E g. when UL synchronisation status is "non-synchronised"

     U 21c phase - Radio Link Failure (RLF):
       > Possible recovery through an RRC Connection Reestablishment
         procedure

             is made available
       > If no recovery within 2nd phase, UE goes autonomously to IDLE

        V Expanding coverage
        V Increasing capacity
     > Features
         V RNs are under the full control of the radio access network
         V Processes and forward the received signal
           ' 3 types operations: Layer 1, Layer 2, Layer 3
         V Occur processing delay compared to repeater

        Functions of Relay nodes                                                  瀟脚"心
        口 Backhaul and access resource sharing
          > RN competes for radio resources with UEs in the donor
            eNodeB's cell coverage areas
             V On the backhaul link
                 · RN has to receive and transmit signals from and to the donor eNodeB
             V On the access link
                 · RN has to transmit and receive signals to and from the UEs

            Coordination or separation is necessary in order to avoid the
           也캔，Sm世쁘啣끄킨 of the 帥 cau師g 汁erferenc計이怡 own receiver 沙

          > Separation in frequency
             V Outband RNs(i.e. Type la RNs) use different frequencies for the
               backhaul and access links
             V Interference can occur due to out-of-band and spurious emissions

     eIiC
     : Almost Blank Subframes
     口 Centralized concept (macro + femto scenario)
         > Muting patterns are assumed to be statically configured from OAM
         > Both macro and HeNB needs to know the muting pattern:
            V HeNB will apply the muting pattern (i.e. will mute some of its
              subframes)
            V Macro-eNB needs to know so it only schedule its users close to non-
              allowed CSG HeNBs during muted subirames + can configured Rel-lO
              UEs with appropriate measurement restrictions.
     口 Distributed concept (macro + pico scenario)
         > Muting patterns are assumed to be dynamically configured,
           assisted by new X2 signalling introduced in Rel-l0.
         > Both macro and pica needs to know the muting pattern:
            V Macro-eNB will apply the muting pattern (i.e. will mute some of its
              subframes)
            V Pico-eNB needs to know so it only schedule its users with large range
              extension during muted subframes + can configured Rel-lO UE
              measurement restrictions for those UEs.

5. LIE-Advance의 주요 기술이 아닌 것은7
1) Carrier Aggregation
2) Self Optimizing Net사orks
3) Heterogeneous Networks
4) HSDPA


6. LTE 시스템의 물리계층과 거리가 먼 것은？
1) OF［가너
2) 卜爪卜／10 Spatial Mu出plexing 및 Transm仕 Diver引ty
3)Direct Sequence Spread Spectrum (DSSS)
4) Turbo Code


7. 주파수영역 등화기（FDE）에 대한 다음 설명 중 잘못된 것은？
1) 전송단에서 CP 훅은 디xed Prefix를 사용하여야 한다
2) PAPR이 직접 변조방식에 비해 커질 수 있다
3) 수신단에서 최소한 두 번의 DFT（디a）를 수행해먀 한다
4) 채널의 이산시간 임펄스 응답의 영점仁可이이 단위 원 바깥쪽에 있어도 등화가 가능하다
